summary.text: Rosemary Bayer is a Democratic member of the Michigan Senate, and her caucus biography says she is serving her second term.
She worked in information technology before her election.

paragraphs.text: Bayer is the daughter of a former mayor, a military service member and the founder of a local community foundation.
Before the Senate she had a career in information technology, first as a computer engineer and analyst.
She serves on the boards of NEW, Solutions for Nonprofits and the SheHive, and she cofounded the Michigan Council of Women in Technology.
In the Senate she has worked on firearm safety legislation, and she lives in West Bloomfield with her husband, John.
